test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Sept, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Dev and Goyal together can do a piece of work in 14 days and Dev alone can do it in 27 days. In how many days can Goyal alone do it?
solution:
**Given:**

Dev and Goyal together can do a piece of work in 14 days.

Dev alone can do it in 27 days.

**Formula Used:**

1. Work done by Dev and Goyal together in 1 day = 1/14

2. Work done by Dev alone in 1 day = 1/27

3. Work done by Goyal alone in 1 day = Work done by (Dev + Goyal) in 1 day - Work done by Dev in 1 day

4. Time taken by Goyal alone to do the work = 1 / Work done by Goyal in 1 day

**Calculation:**

Work done by Dev and Goyal together in 1 day = 1/14

Work done by Dev alone in 1 day = 1/27

Work done by Goyal alone in 1 day = 1/14 - 1/27

⇒ Work done by Goyal alone in 1 day = (27 - 14) / (14 × 27)

⇒ Work done by Goyal alone in 1 day = 13 / (14 × 27)

⇒ Time taken by Goyal alone to do the work = (14 × 27) / 13

⇒ Time = 378 / 13

⇒ Time = 29 ¹/₁₃

**Goyal alone can do the work in 29 ¹/₁₃ days.**
